description: Add type safety to the `files` option in `browser.runtime.executeScript` by restricting it to valid script paths. Currently, the API accepts any string array without validation, leading to runtime errors when non-existent scripts are specified. Update the type definitions to reference the generated `ScriptPublicPath` union type.
functional_requirements: Update the TypeScript type definition for `browser.runtime.executeScript` to restrict the `files` option to the `ScriptPublicPath` union type
Ensure the type change provides proper IntelliSense/autocomplete for valid script paths in IDEs
Maintain backward compatibility where possible, but note that this is a breaking change for consumers specifying non-existent scripts
